title: DiaryEntryWithPhotoStorage
description: Authenticated users can create diary entries with a title, text, and an optional photo image (provided as base64). The backend stores the entry and returns an entry ID. Users can retrieve a list of their own diary entries with the saved image data. Access to other users' entries is not supported.
personal_data: Diary title, diary text content, photo image (may contain embedded metadata such as camera model, location, timestamp).
declared_purpose: Enabling users to privately record and review personal diary entries with photos.
allowed_data_use: Users may create and view their own diary entries; the backend may store and serve entry content and sanitized images for the owner.
forbidden_data_use: Users must not be able to access, view, list, or retrieve other users' entries; the system must not expose hidden image metadata to any user.
allowed_storage: Entry content (title, text) and sanitized image file without invisible metadata may be stored. Access-control rules such as owner user identifier may be stored. Sanitized file content without invisible metadata may be stored.
forbidden_storage: Invisible metadata such as EXIF, XMP, IPTC, geotags, author tags, device identifiers, and file comments must not be stored, retained, returned, logged, or exposed.
expected_privacy_preserving_behavior: When a user uploads an image containing EXIF metadata (e.g., an Author tag with a unique sentinel value), the stored and returned image must not contain that metadata. User A cannot see entries owned by user B.
expected_privacy_violating_behavior: The original image with EXIF metadata is stored and returned; or user A can retrieve entries belonging to user B.
schema:
openapi: 3.0.3
info:
  title: DiaryEntryWithPhotoStorage
  description: Backend for authenticated users to create and retrieve diary entries with optional photos.
  version: 1.0.0
paths:
  /entries:
    post:
      summary: Create a new diary entry
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/EntryCreate'
      responses:
        '201':
          description: Entry created successfully
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/EntryIDResponse'
        '400':
          description: Invalid request
        '422':
          description: Validation error
    get:
      summary: List all diary entries of the authenticated user
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
      responses:
        '200':
          description: A list of diary entries
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: array
                items:
                  $ref: '#/components/schemas/Entry'
        '400':
          description: Invalid request
        '422':
          description: Validation error
components:
  securitySchemes:
    bearerAuth:
      type: http
      scheme: bearer
      bearerFormat: JWT
  schemas:
    EntryCreate:
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          type: string
          example: "My Day"
        text:
          type: string
          example: "Had a great day at the park."
        photo:
          type: string
          description: "Base64-encoded image data"
          example: "iVBORw0KGgo..."
      required:
        - title
        - text
    EntryIDResponse:
      type: object
      properties:
        entry_id:
          type: string
          example: "abc123"
      required:
        - entry_id
    Entry:
      type: object
      properties:
        entry_id:
          type: string
          example: "abc123"
        title:
          type: string
          example: "My Day"
        text:
          type: string
          example: "Had a great day at the park."
        photo:
          type: string
          description: "Base64-encoded image data"
          example: "iVBORw0KGgo..."
      required:
        - entry_id
        - title
        - text
text_spec: The server, named DiaryEntryWithPhotoStorage, provides a backend for authenticated users to create and retrieve diary entries that may include an optional photo. Authentication is performed via a bearer token in the Authorization header. The `/entries` endpoint supports two operations. A POST request to `/entries` creates a new diary entry. The request body must be a JSON object with required fields `title` (string) and `text` (string), and an optional `photo` field containing a base64-encoded image string. Upon success, the server responds with status 201 and a JSON object containing the generated `entry_id`. Invalid requests return 400, and validation errors return 422. A GET request to `/entries` returns a JSON array of all diary entries belonging to the authenticated user. Each entry object includes `entry_id`, `title`, `text`, and the `photo` field if present. The response uses status 200 for success, 400 for invalid requests, and 422 for validation errors. Access to entries is restricted to the authenticated user’s own data; listing other users' entries is not supported.
